name: Detour Onboarding

name: Typegpu
summary: TypeGPU is type-safe WebGPU in TypeScript. Trigger on any mention of typegpu, tgpu, "use gpu", TypedGPU, or WebGPU code written using TypeGPU's schema API (d.*, tgpu.*, std.*). Do NOT trigger for raw WebGPU (using GPUDevice/GPURenderPipeline directly without tgpu), WGSL-only questions, Three.js, Babylon.js, or WebGL.
